sources.title: Qwen3 Next 80B-A3B Instruct · Models · The Open-Source AI Stack
sources.snippet: Preview of a new ultra-sparse Qwen architecture: 80B total, 3B active per token (3.75 percent of params), 512 experts with 10 routed plus 1 shared. Hybrid layout alternates Gated DeltaNet and gated attention. Alibaba reported 10 percent of the training cost of Qwen3-32B and 10x the inference throughput beyond 32K context.
